notes: Sixteen points, no elevation: a ~20 m forward hop followed by a ~1 m out-and-back jitter (never clearing the 5 m threshold), repeated 5 times. The raw haversine sum over every consecutive pair is 110.08297737671097 m (see DERIVATION.md) -- this is the reported distance since distance smoothing was dropped (gpx.ts, `totalDistance = metrics.totalDistance`). The now-unreported smoothed accumulator, ~100.075 m, only advanced its anchor on a hop that cleared the threshold; that value is the counterfactual the retired 5 m gate would have produced, not what this corpus asserts.
